hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *packages/registry/*.yaml|*packages/registry/*.yml) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && pnpm gen:check >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Registry changed and generated artifacts drifted: run pnpm gen before committing (CI fails on drift).' >&2; exit 2; };; esac
